expected.php-accessors/Weather.php:
<?php
namespace AccessorEnabled;
class Weather {
    public string $forecast = 'wet';
    public function getForecast(): string { return $this->forecast; }
    public function setForecast(string $value): void { $this->forecast = $value; }
}
class OtherWeather { public function getWeather(): string { return 'other'; } }
expected.php-accessors/main.php:
<?php
use AccessorEnabled\Weather;
use AccessorEnabled\OtherWeather;
function reportAccessorEnabled(Weather $source): string { $source->setForecast('rain'); return $source->getForecast() . $source->forecast; }
/* 😀 é */ echo reportAccessorEnabled(new Weather()), (new OtherWeather())->getWeather();
// weather and getWeather stay text
$literal='weather';
